proposal_rationale: Read context/baseline.json, context/protocol.json, and both complete captured feedback records, including immutable build/evaluation/report.json at commits 7a85d34af02b69c6f2d5628c6eb52c53d1841042 and 7fa00985e4c08a46daf7f8c9ad407ce3643064e3. Their history contains baseline (40,0.55,0,0) and candidates (40,0.55,1,0) and (40,0.55,1,10); (40,0.55,1,20) is untried, within the frozen domain, and uses the third and final new physical candidate. Raising repair_margin from 0 to 10 reduced max_slew violations from 12 to 2 and max_cap violations from 5 to 0; max_fanout remained 0. Cell area changed from 157315 to 157230 um2, versus baseline 161954 um2, while setup/hold slack changed from 0.423833/0.0655785 to 0.556154/0.0603264 ns. Both candidates failed electrical qualification and have no workload energy measurements. Choose repair_margin=20, the next and largest allowed margin, to target the remaining slew failures while retaining the observed approximately 2.92% cell-area saving; hold utilization, density, and abc_area fixed to follow the observed repair response. Violation counts do not establish severity or guarantee that further margin will qualify, and repair may increase area or energy or reduce hold slack. The baseline remains the only rank-eligible result, with score 1.0. The objective is normalized cell area times geometric-mean normalized DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energy; no improved score, energy, or qualification is claimed before independent evaluation. Energy comparisons use the baseline Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF. RTL, 10526 ps period, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen. No EDA, screening search, external model, or agent was invoked.
